description: Synthetic query-classification dev set. Query text only, no corpus content, placeholder requirement IDs, no real plan codes, no real operator codes, no real release labels. Operator codes are written as {MNO_A}/{MNO_B}/{MNO_C} and filled in at load time from the analyzer's alias table, first-appearance order; release labels are fictitious future months. Labels are authored from human-read intent, NOT from rule output.
